reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text:
This was my first time trying this cleansing oil, and I really liked how light and comfortable it felt. It removes sunscreen and makeup well, emulsifies easily, and doesn’t leave a heavy oily film behind.
I enjoyed trying this cleanser because it feels gentle and fresh on the skin. It cleans well without leaving my face tight or dry, so it feels suitable for everyday use.
reviews.zh:
呢支卸妝油係我第一次用，感覺好清爽舒服。佢可以有效咁卸走防曬同妝，好容易乳化，用完之後唔會剩低一層厚厚嘅油膜。
我好鍾意呢支潔膚產品，搽上面感覺溫和清爽。清潔力夠強之餘又唔會令皮膚繃緊或者乾燥，感覺好適合每日使用。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: I’ve been using this serum for a couple of weeks and I’m honestly impressed. It feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and doesn’t leave my skin sticky. My skin looks more hydrated, smoother, and has a healthy glow. It layers well with the rest of my skincare and hasn’t caused any irritation. I would definitely repurchase and recommend it to anyone looking for a gentle, hydrating serum.C
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢支精華幾個禮拜，老實講真係好滿意。質地清爽、吸收得快，而且用完皮膚唔會黐笠。皮膚望落更加保濕、更加滑，而且有健康嘅光澤。佢同其他護膚品都好夾，冇引起過任何刺激。如果你想搵一支溫和保濕嘅精華，我一定會再買，亦都會推薦畀任何人。C

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: I use this combo to take my make up off, the scent is nice and it does what it needs to do and isn't too harsh on the skin. I cannot use the Anua Heartleaf cleansing oil as it is way too harsh on my skin and gives me a bad reaction. This one is perfect! I have repurchased many times! Everything Round Lab touches turns to gold so you cannot go wrong with any of their products
reviews.zh: 我用呢個組合嚟卸妝，味道唔錯，做到佢應該做到嘅嘢，而且對皮膚唔算太刺激。我用唔到 Anua 嘅 Heartleaf 卸妝油，因為對我嚟講太刺激，會引起不良反應。呢支就啱晒！回購咗好多次！Round Lab 出嘅嘢冇一樣令人失望，所以買佢哋任何產品都唔會中伏。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text:
This is my favorite cleansing oil of all time. I have used many throughout the years, and there has been nothing as good as this one.

This oil takes majority of my makeup off, but I would still recommend using cleansing water after. It definitely cleans out the pores as well. The oil is a bit lighter than what I have used before, and it has a bit of a woodsy(?) scent to it.
reviews.zh:
呢支係我成世人用過最鍾意嘅卸妝油。多年嚟用過好多，但係冇一支比得上。

呢支油可以卸走大部分嘅妝，不過我依然建議之後再用卸妝水。佢亦都可以清淨毛孔。比起以前用過嘅油，呢支感覺清爽少少，而且有少少木系(?)嘅味道。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: I like it. It has a stronger smell, which I’m normally against, however it didn’t bother me that much and it disappeared quickly. I liked that it cleaned my face quite well and wasn’t stripping. I feel like it’s typical oil consistency (not light but not very thick either). It helped my very slightly with my breakouts and skin texture, but I know other cleansing oils that could help a bit more. It’s possible that I will repurchase somewhere in future. Overall I really enjoyed it.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意。味道比較濃，我通常唔鍾意太濃嘅味道，不過呢支就唔算太困擾，而且好快就散咗。我鍾意佢清潔力幾好，而且唔會抽乾皮膚水分。質地方面我覺得係典型嘅油類質感（唔算清爽但亦都唔算好杰）。對我嘅暗瘡同膚質有少少幫助，但係我知道有其他卸妝油可以更加有幫助。將來可能會回購。整體嚟講我真係好享受用佢。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: After 1 month of using it: I have combination sensitive skin, anything with essential oils and fragrance causes severe rashes for me. The Dokdo cleansing oil DID NOT irritate me at all, and was very effective at cleansing. I wear medium coverage makeup everyday and sunscreen. I can’t say if it can remove really stubborn eye makeup, but it removes my waterproof mascara and eyeliner just fine. The formula is lightweight and emulsified easily. It did not leave any film or residue after rinsing with water. I definitely recommend and I consider it safe for sensitive skin. It doesn’t strip my skin of moisture either. I wouldn’t say it has special features like SOOTHING or MOISTURIZING your skin, but as a cleanser itself it is very good. But, the pump is very stiff and inconvenient to use, I end up having to use 2-3 pumps worth of oil to cleanse my face and neck. I might buy it again though.
reviews.zh: 用咗 1 個月之後：我係混合性敏感肌，任何含有精油同香料嘅產品都會令我嚴重出紅疹。Dokdo 卸妝油完全冇刺激到我，而且清潔效果好強。我每日都化中等遮瑕度嘅妝同搽防曬。眼妝特別頑固嗰啲我唔敢講，但係卸到防水睫毛液同眼線就完全冇問題。質地清爽，容易乳化。用清水沖完之後冇留低任何油膜或者殘留物。敏感肌用我都會推薦，認為係安全嘅。佢亦都唔會抽乾皮膚水分。雖然我唔會話佢有 SOOTHING 或者 MOISTURIZING 等特別功效，但係作為一支潔膚產品佢係好好嘅。不過，個泵好硬好難唧，結果我要用 2-3 泵嘅油先可以清到塊面同條頸。雖然係咁，我可能都會再買。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: It wasn't for me tbh. I know it does good for many people, but apparently, this product has a lot of essential oils that can cause breakouts in sensitive skin. Even after emulsifying and thoroughly washing out and pairing it with a water-based cleanser, the product still left a residue on my skin. Either that or it was causing an overproduction of oil for me. Either way, it caused breakouts and wouldn't stop, so I had to give it away. If you have sensitive combo/dry skin, maybe try something else
reviews.zh: 老實講，呢支唔啱我。我知道佢對好多人嚟講都係好用嘅，但係呢支產品含好多精油，敏感肌用可能會爆瘡。就算有乳化同徹底沖乾淨，再配搭水狀潔面產品一齊用，產品依然會喺皮膚上面留低殘留物。要唔係咁，就係令到我皮膚過度出油。總之就係不停咁爆瘡，所以我要將佢送走。如果係敏感肌、混合性或者乾性皮膚，可能要試其他產品。

reviews.shade: Round Lab 1025 Dokdo Cleansing Oil 200ml Special Set (+Dokdo Cleanser 40ml)
reviews.text: I haven’t had acne in 10 years and after one week I of using this, I’ve started having crazy breakouts. This was the only thing I introduced to my skincare routine so I know for a fact it was because of this product. It doesn’t hydrate my skin more than normal, does nothing for my blackheads, and hasn’t changed the appearance of my pores. The texture is nice and it does wash off easy so there’s no greasy feeling, I double cleanse so that isn’t an issue usually but even with double cleansing, the product must still be lingering and causing this issue.
reviews.zh: 我已經 10 年冇生暗瘡，但係用咗呢支產品一個禮拜之後就開始爆晒瘡。呢支係我護膚程序入面唯一新加入嘅嘢，所以我百分百肯定係因為佢。佢冇比正常更加保濕，對黑頭完全冇幫助，毛孔外觀亦都冇改變。質地係好嘅，而且容易沖走，所以唔會有油笠感。我平時會 double cleanse，所以呢個通常唔係問題，但係就算 double cleanse 完，產品應該仲有殘留喺皮膚度，所以先會出現呢個問題。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
